title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer

LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil

REPortS TO:

R&D Manager

Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.

Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.

Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.

Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.

Education:

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.

Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.

Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.

Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.

Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
Descrição da vaga

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado;
  • Contribuir para a evolução da jornada do consumidor no Shopping, assegurando a aderência e a aplicação consistente dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Coordenar a execução dos treinamentos de atendimento destinados a todos os colaboradores que atuam diretamente com o público;
  • Gerir o programa de reconhecimento voltado para o time de campo, equipes terceirizadas e orgânicas;
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS;
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz;
  • Assegurar a manutenção dos padrões de ambiência do mall, por meio do acompanhamento contínuo de aspectos como limpeza, iluminação, sinalização e organização dos espaços comuns;
  • Atuar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria na percepção de qualidade do shopping, propondo ajustes e ações que elevem a experiência do cliente no mall;

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Conhecimento dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Habilidade em elaboração e gerenciamento de orçamento para a área;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;

Informações adicionais:

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation.

About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up—while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role. We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's a fundamental shift in how agencies operate.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO's platform.
  • You'll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere

title: Projetista Elétrico Pleno
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Objetivo do Cargo

Projetista Elétrico Pleno será responsável por desenvolver projetos de infraestrutura elétrica para plantas industriais, atuará na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, especificações de materiais e equipamentos, e auxiliará na preparação de documentação para cotações de montagem elétrica, contribuindo ativamente para a execução de projetos inovadores e eficientes.

Atribuições:

  • Elaboração de Desenhos Técnicos: Desenvolver e detalhar projetos de infraestrutura elétrica para plantas industriais, incluindo layouts, rotas de cabos, detalhamento de suportes típicos de instalação, utilizando software AutoCAD / Plant 3D.
  • Modelagem 3D: Criar e revisar modelos 3D de instalações elétricas em ambiente Plant 3D ou ferramenta similar, garantindo a compatibilidade com projeto mecânico e a otimização do espaço.
  • Dimensionamento e Especificação: Realizar o dimensionamento e a especificação de componentes elétricos como leitos e eletrocalhas, bandejas, eletrodutos, condutores, e demais equipamentos relacionados à solução.
  • Elaboração de Documentação Técnica: Preparar especificações técnicas para compra de materiais e serviços, memórias de cálculo, listas de materiais e outros documentos pertinentes ao projeto.
  • Requisições de Cotação: Auxiliar na elaboração e detalhamento de requisições de cotação para montagem elétrica, garantindo clareza e precisão para fornecedores.
  • Aplicação de Normas: Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com as normas técnicas aplicáveis, com especial atenção às NBR 5410 (Instalações Elétricas de Baixa Tensão), NBR 5419 (Proteção de Estruturas Contra Descargas Atmosféricas) e NBR-IEC (Atmosferas Explosivas – Projeto, Seleção e Montagem de Instalações Elétricas).
  • Interface com Outras Disciplinas: Trabalhar em colaboração com outras equipes de engenharia (mecânica e processo) para garantir a integração e a compatibilidade dos projetos.
  • Suporte à Montagem: Prestar suporte técnico à equipe de montagem durante a execução do projeto, esclarecendo dúvidas e propondo soluções para eventuais desafios.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Curso Técnico em Eletrotécnica ou Eletroeletrônica com experiência relevante e comprovada.
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência como Projetista Elétrico, preferencialmente em projetos industriais. Experiência em plantas químicas será um diferencial.

Benefícios

title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Title: IT Support Engineer

Full Time

Location: Mogi das Cruzes, São Paulo, Brazil

Scope of Work

This is a IT Support (Deskside Support) position for one of our clients in Jundiai, Brazil

The selected candidate will provide on-site technical support covering IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, and hardware troubleshooting. You will work closely with internal teams, customer teams, and remote technical specialists to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Responsibilities include monitoring system health, supporting network devices, troubleshooting VOIP phones, managing basic server tasks, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations following SLA guidelines.

Who We Are – Teceze

Teceze is a global IT solutions and managed services provider, delivering end-to-end support across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. We specialize in providing reliable, secure, and scalable IT services that empower organizations to operate seamlessly. By joining Teceze, you become part of a highly collaborative and technically strong team focused on excellence, innovation, and customer success.

This role is being offered as a Full Time position for one of our key clients, ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining service quality on-site.

Job Description:

Basic Knowledge of Network Devices such as Switches, Routers, Wireless Access Points preferably CISCO, Riverbed

• Basics knowledge / understanding of assigning switch ports to specific VLANs

• Patch phone ports to switch as needed

• Basic troubleshooting of Avaya VOIP phones (knowledge on basic configuration)

• Troubleshoot issues with fiber links between switches – Able to visualize errors and communicate to remote technical teams

• Troubleshoot and replace network switch chassis blades when required

• Good to have understanding of any Data Center Infrastructure Management Application

• A periodic (minimum twice weekly) visual check of the IDF rooms for cooling and power status (specifically UPS alarms and PDU health) Control-M, EMC Avamar, Data Domain

• Basic Knowledge of Monitoring tools such as Solarwinds, etc...

• Networking and Operating System basics

• Assist network and data center admins (Internal, Customer and Vendor) as required during the course of technical troubleshooting

• Basic knowledge about Hardware like Servers, Storage devices

• Knowledge to understand Monitoring Tool outcome

• Basic knowledge of ITSM tool preferably ServiceNow

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B" e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Farroupilha - RS

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Machine Learning Engineer

uv para gerenciamento de ambiente Python

Orientação a resultados com foco em disponibilidade e escalabilidade

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Backend Pleno
description:
Vaga PJ para trabalho híbrido, 2x por semana, no Parque de Inovação Tecnológica em São dos José dos Campos.

Sobre a ALTAVE

Proteger vidas e recursos com tecnologia, nisto consiste o propósito da ALTAVE.

Possuímos como clientes empresas líderes do mercado de óleo e gás, como Petrobrás e seus fornecedores, e de mineração, como Vale e Samarco. Fundada há 14 anos em São José dos Campos por engenheiros do ITA, a ALTAVE iniciou recentemente sua expansão internacional com clientes nos EUA, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes e Malásia.

Para atendê-los, desenvolvemos avançadas soluções de inteligência artificial para automatizar emissão de alertas por câmeras.

Temos um ambiente de trabalho vibrante e acolhedor, e especial para quem compartilham os nossos valores:

2. Integridade e Honestidade

3. Relacionamentos baseados em Confiança mútua

4. Autotomia baseada em vontade, responsabilidade e excelência

5. Somos Espirituosos

Sua Missão

Você será protagonista na evolução de sistemas críticos que sustentam as soluções ALTAVE em visão computacional, IA e gestão de alertas.

Sua missão envolve:

  • Desenvolvimento de Funcionalidades: Codificar novas fatures de ponta a ponta, garantindo código limpo, eficiente e escalável.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Participar ativamente de revisões, compartilhando conhecimento, garantindo padrões de qualidade e aprendendo com o time.

  • Testes e Qualidade: Escrever testes unitários, de integração e garantir que o que vai para produção seja robusto e confiável.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e resolver débitos técnicos, refatorar códigos legados e sugerir melhorias em processos e tecnologias.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com +5 anos em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação (preferencialmente Python).
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes e protocolos de comunicação.
  • Prática em testes automatizados e TDD (Test-Driven Development).
  • Experiência em Cloud Computing (AWS e/ou GCP).
  • Inglês intermediário.

Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Banco de dados: relacional (PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (Redis, MongoDB).
  • Mensageria com RabbitMQ.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Sistemas operacionais Linux (Debian/Ubuntu).
  • Automação com GitHub Actions, Ansible e Terraform.
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes.

Se você é apaixonado por Arquitetura e Engenharia de Software, Cloud e DevOps e busca um ambiente desafiador e inspirador para crescer profissionalmente, venha fazer parte da ALTAVE. Aqui cada contribuição conta na proteção de vidas e recursos com tecnologia.

Na ALTAVE você encontrará:

Trabalhar na ALTAVE é incrível! Você encontrará uma estrutura que estimula autonomia com responsabilidade, aprendizado contínuo e atuação ao lado de um time altamente qualificado. Aqui você encontrará projetos desafiadores, espaço real para crescimento, participação ativa em decisões e envolvimento em iniciativas que geram impacto direto no campo e na gestão. Nosso ambiente promove colaboração, alta performance e networking com grandes players nacionais e internacionais.

Tudo isso sustentado por remuneração e benefícios competitivos e um plano de carreira estruturado para quem entrega resultado e busca evolução.

Somos Great Place To Work!

Benefícios? Muitos!

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, TotalPass, Clude, Flash, day off no aniversário e muito mais!

title: Coordenadora de Engenharia de Software | Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:
SOBRE NÓS

Dá para (r)evolucionar o agro no digital? Nós acreditamos que sim!

Olá, nós somos a Orbia, uma empresa de tecnologia brasileira dedicada à transformação digital do agronegócio. Com orgulho, somos a maior plataforma digital integrada do setor na América Latina, conectando mais de 284 mil usuários no Brasil.

Com pioneirismo no nosso DNA, reunimos soluções organizadas em três pilares principais:

Orbia Compras: sua rede de compras no agro | Um marketplace robusto para compras online de insumos agrícolas, oferecendo cobertura nacional por meio de mais de 300 distribuidores, revendas e indústrias parceiras.

Orbia Clube: sua rede de vantagens e benefícios no agro | O maior programa de pontos, fidelidade e coalizão do agro no Brasil, com mais de 10 empresas parceiras e um catálogo com mais de 25 mil produtos e serviços.

Orbia Pag: sua rede de soluções financeiras no agro | Um hub financeiro que oferece crédito de forma ágil e digital para produtores rurais adquirirem insumos com segurança.

Tudo isso de forma 100% digital, segura e prática, sem que nossos clientes precisem sair de casa ou da fazenda.

Desde o nosso início, em 2019, contamos com bases sólidas e acionistas de renome no setor, como Bayer, Bravium, Yara Fertilizantes e Itaú BBA. Todos acreditam em nosso potencial de crescimento, em dois dos maiores mercados globais: tecnologia e agronegócio.

Os nossos #Orbians , como chamamos carinhosamente o nosso time de talentos, são pessoas diversas, únicas e motivadas a enfrentar grandes desafios. Aqui, você é o protagonista da sua história! Juntos, estamos construindo o futuro da Orbia e do agronegócio.

NOSSOS VALORES

Empreendedorismo

Diversidade

Confiabilidade

Resultado

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • A Pessoa Coordenadora de Engenharia tem um papel fundamental no desenho de arquitetura e orientação técnica da equipe, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade nas entregas e contribuindo para o crescimento técnico e colaborativo do time.
  • Atuará na definição e implementação de uma arquitetura eficiente, equilibrando o uso de plataformas externas, para otimização de custos, e desenvolvimentos internos, assegurando a gestão do conhecimento e a conduzirá a construção do roadmap técnico em colaboração com o Product Manager (PM) e Producto Design (PD), negociando priorização adequada dentro do seu escopo de atuação.

REQUISITOS

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes de tecnologia, com um histórico de sucesso na entrega de projetos complexos e de alta escalabilidade.
  • Habilidade para desenvolver e implementar estratégias tecnológicas que suportem os objetivos de negócio.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD)
  • Familiaridade com containers e tecnologias de orquestração, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com serviços e infraestruturas em nuvem: preferencialmente AWS
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento, log e análise de performance de aplicações e infraestrutura, utilizando ferramentas como Grafana, Kibana, New Relic, ou similares.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) e ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (Jira, Trello, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web React/Next ou TypeScript
  • Backend Java, Kotlin ou Node
  • Bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Espanhol intermediário.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Remuneração variável de curto prazo vinculada ao atingimento de metas corporativas;
  • Benefícios flexíveis: Valor para dividir entre vale refeição, vale alimentação, programa de pontos para viagens e hospedagens, plano de saúde para seu pet, transporte e cartão Flash;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Assistência Médica: Seguros Unimed, pago integralmente pela empresa para titular e dependentes;
  • Assistência odontológica: Plano Care Plus, pago integralmente pela empresa para titular e dependentes.;
  • Previdência Privada: Plano Brasilprev;
  • Seguro de Vida: Zurich;
  • TotalPass: Benefício corporativo que oferece acesso a diversas academias e estúdios de atividades físicas para funcionários de empresas parceiras, promovendo bem-estar e qualidade de vida. title: Data Annotator
description:

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor's degree

We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.

  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mandatory.
  • Good proficiency in the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation, linguistic evaluation, or AI training projects.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • .Fully remote opportunity, allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology.

Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: AI-First Frontend Engineer (Next.js & React) - Remote
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)

Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.

You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.

Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the "Clinical OS" — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.

Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The "Beautiful Web" Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.

Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don't bolt AI on — it's embedded in how we build. You'll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You'll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role, designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently, owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

This is not a transactional AP role.

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity, requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers, and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting, FP&A, and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone, without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments, especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.

Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.

To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:

CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)

The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.

This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.

Main activities:

  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise

Experience / Education / Special Requirements

You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.

You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.

Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.

You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.

Please submit your application and CV in English.

Why join ECHOSENS ?

  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.

ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.

To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:

Area Sales Manager

General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company's agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.

Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA's.

A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.

You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer's specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.

"You're part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You're a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware."

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.

Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

title: Training Expert
description:
Drive and scale data-driven training programs for large operations, turning quality insights into structured learning strategies and SOPs that improve performance.

Own the full training lifecycle across in-house and BPO teams, from needs analysis to impact measurement.

Ideal for profiles with experience in CX, operations, or delivery/e-commerce environments, combining analytics, training, and cross-regional collaboration.

Training Strategy and Needs Identification Common Problem Modeling: Regularly review internal and external (BPO/direct sales) quality reports produced by the quality inspection team, using data analysis to identify high-frequency errors, persistent pain points, and systemic risks. Differentiated Strategy Development: Develop tiered and categorized annual/quarterly training strategies tailored to the different business characteristics, personnel qualities, and turnover rates of direct sales employees and the BPO team.

Training Process Construction and Standardization Closed-Loop Process Construction: Establish a standardized closed-loop chain of "quality inspection discovery - problem attribution - course development - training implementation - assessment and acceptance - business feedback". Knowledge Base Management: Responsible for the dynamic updating of business SOPs, transforming best practices after quality inspection corrections into replicable case studies.

Training Implementation and Collaboration Courseware Development: Organize or independently develop multimedia training materials for business rule changes, quality notices, and new employee onboarding. Diverse Delivery: Responsible for cross-regional and cross-team training coordination. For BPO companies, empower their internal trainers (Train the Trainer); for core business points, personally conduct on-the-job training.

Assessment, Evaluation, and Continuous Improvement Effectiveness Evaluation: Establish a post-training assessment mechanism, including but not limited to exam scores, simulation exercises, and on-the-job certification. Quality Tracking: Monitor the business quality curve after training over the long term. If the error rate does not significantly decrease after training, secondary attribution and adjustments to the training plan are required.

Requirements:

  • Experience in the internet industry, with preference given to candidates possessing experience in food delivery platforms, instant delivery, e-commerce operations, or large customer service center training.
  • Large-Scale Team Management Experience: Experience leading training for a direct sales team of over 100 people, or practical experience managing training systems for large BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) partners, familiar with the pain points of high BPO staff turnover and difficulty in implementing standards.
  • Data-Driven and Value Output Data-Driven Thinking: Exceptional data acumen; proficient in using data analysis tools to drill down into quality metrics and identify common problems.
  • Result Quantification Ability: Ability to clearly and logically demonstrate the actual contribution of training investment to business value through data (eg, error rate reduction, per capita efficiency improvement, customer complaint conversion rate, etc.).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), able to act as a communication bridge between teams from different countries/regions, understanding and balancing differences between headquarters standards and localized implementation.
  • Cross-Regional Collaboration: Possess cross-cultural collaboration awareness, able to develop effective empowerment programs for employees from different regional backgrounds.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations use their technology today, and they process over $5 Billion of payments annually.

  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies

  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies

  • Perform high-quality peer reviews

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.js, React.js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Ao se juntar a nós, você não apenas se torna parte de nossa história de sucesso, você ajuda a moldar o futuro e continua nosso rico legado que começou lá em 1874.

No Brasil somos a Atlas Schindler, estamos no país desde 1918, com mais de 100 anos de história. Fabricamos, instalamos, modernizamos e prestamos o melhor serviço de manutenção para elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes. Somos líderes do segmento de mobilidade urbana no Brasil, e procuramos para trabalhar com a gente pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores, que promovam um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para colegas e realizem um serviço excepcional aos clientes.

Banco de Talentos - Analista de Projetos de Obras Sr

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e monitorar os processos Fullfilment + desde a prospecção e venda até a entrega do equipamento e atendimento às instalações existentes nos negócios de Novas Instalações (NI) e Modernizações (MOD). Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Atuar como ponto focal dos projetos, mantendo comunicação eficaz com os clientes para assegurar satisfação e conformidade contratual. Além disso, acompanhar e controlar a performance financeira dos projetos.

Quais os Requisitos?

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas a Gestão de Projetos.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de projetos.
  • Conhecimento técnico em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (AutoCAD ou similares).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis em obras e equipamentos.
  • Habilidade para controle orçamentário (pré e pós-cálculo) e análise de viabilidade econômica de projetos.
  • Excelente relacionamento interpessoal, com forte orientação estratégica para resultados. Expertise em organização e planejamento de processos, comunicação assertiva com equipes multidisciplinares e clientes. Habilidade avançada em negociação, gestão de prazos e tomada de decisão, garantindo segurança, qualidade e satisfação do cliente. Atuação como referência técnica e estratégica, promovendo melhorias contínuas e alinhamento aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office e SAP.
  • Inglês avançado.

O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

title: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho Sênior
description:
Inscrições abertas até 10/04.

Trabalhamos por um único propósito: desenvolver o mundo com energia limpa em larga escala, e para alcançarmos este objetivo, acreditamos que as pessoas são parte fundamental desse processo.

Estamos buscando Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho Sênior que atuará em nosso parque eólico na região da Serra da Palmeira/PB. A base será em Picuí/PB.

Essa pessoa será responsável por:

  • Apoiar a elaboração e atualização de análises de risco, normas e procedimentos.
  • Orientar colaboradores sobre uso de EPIs, normas e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Apoiar a implementação das NRs e auditorias em fornecedores.
  • Atuar na investigação de acidentes, SIPAT, treinamentos, CIPA e campanhas de prevenção.
  • Elaborar e implementar programas e procedimentos de segurança conforme padrões corporativos, com realização de treinamentos para colaboradores próprios e terceiros.
  • Integração de novos colaboradores.
  • Orientar colaboradores sobre uso de EPIs, normas e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Liberação de Permissões de Trabalho (PT) para atividades críticas (altura, trabalho a quente, LOTO, movimentação de cargas, espaço confinado, escavações, entre outros).
  • Realizar inspeções diárias e identificar riscos e não conformidades.
  • Análise e investigação de acidentes, incidentes e desvios.
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de Segurança TFSA, TFCA, TG, entre outros.
  • Atuar no Plano de Resposta a Emergência – PRE do Complexo Eólico.
  • Suporte as atividades de comunicação social e ambiental nas comunidades da área de influência do Complexo.
  • Atuar juntamente com a CIPA, nas reuniões, campanhas de prevenção e SIPAT.

Buscamos profissional que tenha:

  • Formação técnica completa em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Experiência com projetos de energia renovável, preferencialmente Parque Eólico.
  • Vivência no acompanhamento de atividades de alto risco, como trabalho em altura, espaço confinado, eletricidade, içamento de cargas, entre outros.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação alocado em campo.
  • Experiência em gestão de normas, procedimentos e documentação de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Experiência com auditorias, investigações de acidentes e treinamentos de SST.
  • Bons conhecimentos no Pacote Office.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Conhecimento em ferramenta Power BI e Inglês básico/intermediário será um diferencial.

Benefícios que geram energia:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Remuneração Variável Anual (PPR)
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Auxílio Transporte, Fretado ou Estacionamento (a depender da localidade)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • TotalPass (Auxílio Academia e Bem-estar)
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade estendida
  • Gift Card no mês do seu aniversário
  • Gift Card de Natal

Em nossos processos seletivos, consideramos pessoas com deficiência e de diferentes etnias, nacionalidades, gênero e orientação sexual. Dessa forma, contribuímos com uma sociedade e um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo, em que a diversidade nos permitirá ir ainda mais longe.

Com sua Energia podemos ir mais longe, vamos juntos?

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
Manager, Finance Analysis (FP&A)

Brazil (Hybrid: 3 days onsite)

A fast-growing consumer goods company is looking for a Manager, Finance Analysis (FP&A) to lead financial performance initiatives across their international business. This role focuses on product and customer profitability, cost management, and strategic decision support, with direct impact on business growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse revenue, expenses, cash flow, and profitability, with a focus on products, channels, and customers
  • Monitor trends and performance to identify risks and opportunities
  • Lead category, brand, and margin analysis, including rebates and cost control
  • Own budgeting and forecasting processes, providing variance analysis and actionable insights
  • Build financial models and business cases for pricing strategies, product launches, and market expansion
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to ensure data accuracy and alignment with business goals
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Mentor and develop a direct report, promoting collaboration within the finance team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, or related roles (CPG experience preferred)
  • Strong understanding of US market dynamics
  • Advanced skills in Excel, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, D365), and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Excellent communicator, able to influence senior stakeholders
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities

Preferred

  • Experience with A&P ROI, new product business cases, and pricing strategies
  • Knowledge of customer/channel profitability, NRVA/GMVA analysis, and US GAAP

title: COORDENADOR DE GENTE E GESTÃO JÚNIOR
description:
Sobre a MV

Somos a 3a maior empresa de TI do Brasil. Apoiamos organizações de Saúde desde a estruturação da gestão até a construção da cultura de inovação. Com a missão de tornar o segmento mais eficiente e digital, a MV sempre contribuiu com o avanço da Saúde Digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras que mudaram o cenário de centenas de instituições.

Nosso Jeito de Ser

Compartilhados por todas as nossas áreas de negócio e em todas as regiões onde atuamos, o "Nosso Jeito de Ser" nos leva a uma cultura de alta performance, atingida pelo engajamento das pessoas. Essa estratégia detalhada é a alma da nossa instituição e deve ser uma fonte permanente de orientação e inspiração em todas as decisões institucionais.

VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL EM RECIFE

Qual o desafio da vaga?

Liderar o time de Administração de Pessoal com a responsabilidade de acompanhar e desenvolver;

Realizar feedback, elaborar PDI, Plano de Aprendizagem e Avaliação de Desempenho;

Coordenar as folhas de pagamento de colaboradores nos vínculos CLT, PJ e Terceiros;

Controlar a apuração e recolhimento dos encargos;

Orientar e auditar a execução das rotinas trabalhistas junto à equipe;

Gerir o sistema de informações gerenciais das contas financeiras relacionadas a salários, encargos e benefícios;

Apoiar a análise e correção de inconsistências em integrações de sistemas;

Realizar benchmarking para troca de experiências, por meio da participação em grupos de RH ou instituições;

Estabelecer e manter políticas e processos de administração de pessoal compatíveis com a legislação vigente;

Analisar e propor as ações de melhorias dos indicadores de desempenho da área;

Acompanhar e controlar o contencioso judicial, fornecendo as informações necessárias para a defesa e indicando os representantes legais (prepostos) à área jurídica;

Fornecer orientação trabalhista e treinamentos específicos aos gestores nas diversas unidades;

Elaborar e controlar os orçamentos de contas financeiras relativas a despesas com pessoal;

Orientar e coordenar as ações relativas à saúde e segurança do trabalhador, bem como o atendimento da legislação pertinente às características da empresa;

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos da qualidade, adequando suas rotinas aos mesmos;

Monitorar a qualidade dos benefícios e atuar nas ações de satisfação na experiência dos colaboradores;

Realizar mensalmente leitura e análise da DRE da área, garantindo que o realizado estará dentro do orçado planejado;

Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual da área.

O que esperamos de você:

Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Direito, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou área correlatas;

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
